caseName: New Orleans Baptist Theological Seminary v. Babcock
caseNameFull: New Orleans Baptist Theological Seminary v. Babcock

opinions.text:
Ct. App. La., 4th Cir. Motion of respondent for leave to proceed in forma pauperis granted. Motion of Baptist Joint Committee on Public Affairs et al. for leave to file a brief as amici curiae granted. Certiorari denied.

Justice Black-mun would grant certiorari.
